starterPrompts.label: Add a ramp and crates
starterPrompts.prompt: Edit src/models/track.py to add a second Ramp.* wedge and three Crate.* boxes after the first corner. Open Track, rerun the script through the project's Blender MCP, and save track.blend.

starterPrompts.label: Add a boost key
starterPrompts.prompt: Edit src/models/track.play.ts so holding either Shift key boosts forward top speed from 30 to 45 metres per second. Keep braking unchanged.

starterPrompts.label: Rearrange the HUD
starterPrompts.prompt: Edit src/ui/race-hud.tsx to move the speed panel to the bottom right and show JUMP instead of AIR while airborne. Keep the lap timer at the top left.
